db_conflicts.research_value: "de couleur claire, régulier, uni, pas dégradé" (light-colored, uniform, no gradient) — Togo's official e-Visa FAQ does not say specifically white, only "light-colored"

cross_verification.note_en: voyage.gouv.tg is Togo's official government e-Visa portal ("Togo Voyage"). Its FAQ page gives a genuinely detailed official photo standard covering quality, background, expression, glasses, and headwear — unusually thorough for a page of this size. No numeric photo size (cm) or file format/KB spec was found anywhere on the site (voyage.gouv.tg/about, voyage.gouv.tg/faq, or the visa checklist), which only says "Une (1) photo d'identité récente" (one recent ID photo) is mandatory. Togo's separate passport authority DGDN (see tg-passport.json) only confirms background+quantity for the passport photo specifically, so the richer visa-page standard above was NOT cross-applied to the passport record.
